### Setup
```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)
library(ggformula)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,
                      # change to true to cache results
                      cache = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# rows in sim dataset
n <- 500
# size of RE groups
n_re <- 2
# x1 slope
b1 <- 1.5
# x2 slope
b2 <- -0.5
# random intercept standard deviation
group_sd <- 0.5
# residual standard deviation
resid_sd <- 1
```

### Standard Trial
```{r}
acf_values = data.frame(acfs = rep.int(NA, n)) # premade data frame of proper current length

for (i in 1:n) {
  sim_data <- data.frame(
    # values of predictor #1
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    # values of predictor #2
    x2 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    # third candidate predictor that is NOT assoc w/respone
    x3 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    # random effect group assignment
    re_group = gl(n = floor(n/2),
                  k = n_re,
                  length = n),
    # residuals
    resid = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = resid_sd)) |>
    # random intercepts
    group_by(re_group) |>
    mutate(alpha = rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = group_sd)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(response = 0 + alpha + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 + resid) # note: response value does not include x3
  
    model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + (1 | re_group), data = sim_data)
    summary(model)
    acf_out <- acf(resid(model), plot = FALSE)
    acf_values$acfs[i] = acf_out$acf[acf_out$lag == 1] # send values at lag 1 to the premade data frame
}
```

### Find number below the lower bound (needs work)
```{r}
acf_greater = list() # test list for being beyond the bound
counter = 1
for (i in 1:n) {
  if(acf_values$acfs[i] <= -.1) { # the bound is currently set at -.1 based on my eyeballing it
                                  # this will need to change as its actually based on sample size
   acf_greater[counter] <- acf_values$acfs[i]
   counter = counter + 1 # used because if you use i, it creates a lot of empty rows (I know this is kind of a janky setup)
  }
}
```

### Trial without the RE 
```{r}
# without the RE

result <- data.frame(acfs = rep(NA, n),
                     b1 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x1 = rep(NA, n),
                     p_x1 = rep(NA,n),
                     b2 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x2 = rep(NA, n),
                     p_x2 = rep(NA,n),
                     b3 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x3 = rep(NA, n),
                     p_x3 = rep(NA,n)
)


for (i in 1:n) {
  sim_data <- data.frame(
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x2 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x3 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    resid = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = resid_sd)
  ) |>
    mutate(alpha = rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = group_sd)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(response = 0 + alpha + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 + resid)

  model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = sim_data)

  acf_out <- acf(resid(model), plot = FALSE)
  
  coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients$cond)
  
  result$b1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Estimate"]
  
  result$b2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Estimate"]
  
  result$b3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Estimate"]
  
  result$p_x1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  result$p_x2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  result$p_x3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Pr(>|z|)"]

  result$acfs[i] <- acf_out$acf[acf_out$lag == 1]
  
  result$se_x1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Std. Error"]
  
  result$se_x2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Std. Error"]
  
  result$se_x3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Std. Error"]
}
```

```{r}
# ACF lag 1, slopes, SEs, and p-values
glimpse(result)
```

```{r}
# graphs without the RE

gf_histogram(~acfs, data = result)

gf_boxplot(~acfs, data = result)
```

### Random slopes
```{r}
# picking the slopes from a distribution, not just preset
# I used a normal distribution with means of the original values and standard deviation of 1 to create the new slopes

acf_random = data.frame(acfs = rep(NA, n), # premade data frame of proper current length
                     b1 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x1 = rep(NA,n),
                     b2 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x2 = rep(NA,n),
                     b3 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x3 = rep(NA,n)
                     ) 

for (i in 1:n) {
  sim_data <- data.frame(
    # values of predictor #1
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    # values of predictor #2
    x2 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    # third candidate predictor that is NOT assoc w/respone
    x3 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    # random effect group assignment
    b1 = rnorm(n, mean = 1.5, sd = 1),
    b2 = rnorm(n, mean = -.5, sd = 1),
    re_group = gl(n = floor(n/2),
                  k = n_re,
                  length = n),
    # residuals
    resid = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = resid_sd)) |>
    # random intercepts
    group_by(re_group) |>
    mutate(alpha = rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = group_sd)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(response = 0 + alpha + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 + resid) # note: response value does not include x3
  
    model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + (1 | re_group), data = sim_data)
    summary(model)
    acf_out <- acf(resid(model), plot = FALSE)
    acf_random$acfs[i] = acf_out$acf[acf_out$lag == 1] # send values at lag 1 to the premade data frame
}

gf_histogram(~acfs, data = acf_random)
gf_boxplot(~acfs, data = acf_random)

```

### Different Sizes of RE Group with RE vs. no RE
```{r}

# Preallocate result
result <- data.frame(acfs = rep(NA, n),
                     b1 = rep(NA, n),
                     p_x1 = rep(NA, n),
                     b2 = rep(NA, n),
                     p_x2 = rep(NA, n),
                     b3 = rep(NA, n),
                     p_x3 = rep(NA, n),
                     n_re = rep(NA, n),  # number of Random Effect Group
                     re = rep(NA, n))

# for loop

for(i in 1:n){
  
  if(i < n/5){
    n_re <- 2
  } else if(i < 2*n/5){
    n_re <- 4
  } else if(i < 3*n/5){
    n_re <- 8
  } else if(i < 4*n/5){
    n_re <- 16
  } else {
    n_re <- 32
  }
  
  sim_data <- data.frame(
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x2 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x3 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    re_group = gl(n = floor(n / 2), k = n_re, length = n),
    resid = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = resid_sd)
  ) |>
    group_by(re_group) |>
    mutate(alpha = rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = group_sd)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(response = 0 + alpha + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 + resid)
  
  if(i%%2 == 0){
    result$re[i] <- "random effect"
    
    model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + (1 | re_group), data = sim_data)
    
  } else {
    result$re[i] <- "no random effect"
    
    model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = sim_data)
  }

  acf_out <- acf(resid(model), plot = FALSE)
  
  coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients$cond)
  
  result$b1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Estimate"]
  
  result$b2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Estimate"]
  
  result$b3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Estimate"]
  
  result$p_x1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  result$p_x2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  result$p_x3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Pr(>|z|)"]

  result$acfs[i] <- acf_out$acf[acf_out$lag == 1]
  
  result$n_re[i] <- n_re
}

glimpse(result)
```

```{r}
gf_boxplot(re ~ acfs | n_re, color = ~re, data = result) +
  xlab('ACF Value at lag 1') +
  ylab('Random Effect') +
  labs(color = 'RE')

```

### Different Random Effect Standard Deviations with RE vs. no RE
```{r}
# simulation setting

n <- 500 # rows in sim dataset

n_re <- 2 # size of RE groups

b1 <- 1.5 # x1 slope

b2 <- -0.5 # x2 slope

# random intercept standard deviation
group_sd <- 0.5
# residual standard deviation
resid_sd <- 1

# Preallocate result
result <- data.frame(acfs = rep(NA, n),
                     b1 = rep(NA, n),
                     p_x1 = rep(NA, n),
                     b2 = rep(NA, n),
                     p_x2 = rep(NA, n),
                     b3 = rep(NA, n),
                     p_x3 = rep(NA, n),
                     group_sd = rep(NA, n), 
                     re = rep(NA, n)
                     )

# for loop

for(i in 1:n){
  
  if(i < n/5){
    group_sd <- 0.1
    
  } else if(i < 2*n/5){
    group_sd <- 0.25
  } else if(i < 3*n/5){
    group_sd <- 1
  } else if(i < 4*n/5){
    group_sd <- 2
  } else {
    group_sd <- 4
  }
  
  sim_data <- data.frame(
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x2 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x3 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    re_group = gl(n = floor(n / 2), k = n_re, length = n),
    resid = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = resid_sd)
  ) |>
    group_by(re_group) |>
    mutate(alpha = rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = group_sd)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(response = 0 + alpha + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 + resid)
  
  if(i%%2 == 0){
    result$re[i] <- "random effect"
    
    model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + (1 | re_group), data = sim_data)
    
  } else {
    result$re[i] <- "no random effect"
    
    model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = sim_data)
  }

  acf_out <- acf(resid(model), plot = FALSE)

  coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients$cond)

  result$b1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Estimate"]

  result$b2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Estimate"]

  result$b3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Estimate"]

  result$p_x1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Pr(>|z|)"]

  result$p_x2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Pr(>|z|)"]

  result$p_x3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Pr(>|z|)"]

  result$acfs[i] <- acf_out$acf[acf_out$lag == 1]
  
  result$group_sd[i] <- group_sd
  
}
```

```{r}
gf_boxplot(re ~ acfs | group_sd, color = ~re, data = result) +
  xlab('ACF Value at lag 1') +
  ylab('Random Effect') +
  labs(color = 'RE')
```
